messages:
alex: heads-up: ran into messy auth behavior in sampleapp when switching from local to k8s. Node looks for REDWOOD_TOKEN, python sample checks RW_API, and the CLI still favors REDWOOD_KEY. onboarding confusion.
priya: oof. also saw problems with SSO-issued ephemeral tokensthey expire and our SDKs don't surface clear errors. we should document expected lifetime handling.
tony: suggestion: pick a single canonical env var REDWOOD_API_KEY (or REDWOOD_TOKEN for clarity) and provide a tiny cred-watcher sidecar pattern for kube that pushes rotated creds to a unix socket or calls localhost webhook.
nina: +1 for sidecar. also add a small CredProvider interface in each SDK with a `refresh()` hook and an event when token changes so long-running apps can reconfigure clients without restart. include an example for using AWS SecretsManager and a short TTL cache.
devops-bot: note: k8s secrets are case-sensitive; use UPPER_SNAKE and avoid hyphens. mounting the secret as a file is more robust for long JSON tokens.
security: must avoid silent scope elevation. if a project-scoped token is used where an org token is required, fail loudly and log the attempted fallback including scope and requester. audit logs mandatory.
alex: small bug: current node getDefaultToken() returns '\n' when env set to empty string; treat empty or whitespace-only as unset. I'll open a tiny patch.
priya: can devex draft a short PR checklist: canonical env var in READMEs, cred-watcher sidecar example in sampleapp, SDK refresh interface + tests, CLI note for `rw creds reload` and security review?
devex: will do. assigning: priya docs + sidecar example, tony SDK hooks + tests, alex CLI hint + small patch, security to sign off on fallback policy.
